title: EBANX Payment
description: A payment processed by EBANX through the Pay-in Direct API or Payment Page.

hash.description: EBANX-issued unique identifier for the payment.

merchant_payment_code.description: Merchant-provided unique identifier for the payment.

status.description: EBANX status code: PE pending, CA cancelled, OP opened, CO confirmed (paid), PN paid manually.

payment_type_code.description: Local payment method code (e.g., visa, mastercard, pix, boleto, oxxo, spei, pse, efecty).

amount_total.description: Total amount charged to the customer in the local currency.

amount_ext.description: Amount in the merchant pricing currency.

currency_rate.description: FX rate applied between currency_code and currency_ext.

instalments.description: Number of installments selected for card payments.

document.description: Local tax id (CPF, CNPJ, RFC, NIT, etc.).
